info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Case Retrieval API
info.description: The Customer Case Retrieval API allows users to access specific customer case information related to banking services. Utilizing this API, businesses can retrieve detailed insights about open and resolved customer cases to enhance support operations. Typical consumers include customer service representatives and support teams who require quick access to customer issues and their resolutions. This API facilitates better customer engagement by providing essential data needed for informed decision-making and effective case management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific customer case identified by a unique case ID. It provides essential data related to the case and helps in understanding the customer’s situation better.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch the details of the customer case identified by the unique ID 'CUST-100045'. It requires a JSON object containing the necessary parameters for the request.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the customer case details.
